verdict_reason: Branch removal is correct, but two search-within-roles tests no longer fail if the role filter is dropped.

todos.issue: Removing the branch seed left two titles claiming more than their assertions prove. 'Should apply the search term within the roles' (:76-83) now only asserts origin roles plus 'depot' gives [], but no typed seed address is named Depot any more, so it passes with the role filter deleted. 'Should match a search role as it matches a search term, within the roles' (:135-143) lost its BRANCH_ADDRESS case and now only asserts the Origin Farm is found, which also passes with the role filter deleted. Neither test fails if passesRoleFilter (stub.js:86) stops being applied.
todos.fix: Must: each test fails if the stub stops applying roles before the search, and shows a match inside the roles is kept. One way: in the search-term test assert origin roles plus 'importer' gives [] (Stub Importer Farm sits outside them) and plus 'pasture' gives [placeOfOrigin.name]; in the search-role test add destination roles plus searchTerm 'consignor' and searchRoles ['CONSIGNOR'] gives [].
